image_description: A wooden altar situated within a stone alcove featuring arched architecture. The altar consists of a raised rectangular structure with carved paneling, a central niche, and decorative motifs including an anchor symbol. It is topped with a white cloth, two tall candlesticks with black candles, and religious vessels (chalice/ciborium). Behind the altar stands a large, ornate wooden reredos or frame with a reflective central panel (mirror or glass). To the left, a small wooden stool holds additional liturgical items.

artifact_observations.location: Wooden surfaces of the altar and reredos
artifact_observations.reasoning: The wood grain texture appears slightly repetitive and 'painted-on' rather than having deep physical depth. Some edges of the carved details are soft, lacking the crisp sharpness of real woodworking.

artifact_observations.location: Top edge of the reredos/frame and archway
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight warping in the straight lines of the wooden frame behind the altar; the vertical lines bow slightly inward/outward inconsistently with strict linear perspective.
The black void in the central niche lacks internal depth or shadowing, appearing as a flat black shape pasted onto the wood rather than a recessed cavity.
The contact points between the metal objects and the white cloth are slightly blurred, with minor bleeding of the object colors into the cloth texture.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific classification of the object as an altar and distinguish it from general tables or cabinets.
To verify the 3D structure of the niche, the depth of the central cavity, and the separation of the altar from the back wall.
To check for clean boundaries between the metallic objects and the background/cloth, detecting any fusion or melting artifacts.
To assess the realism of the wood grain and carved details, identifying any AI-generated smearing or pattern repetition.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the central niche (depth vs. flat black patch)
Realism of wood grain texture and carved details
Geometric consistency of the reredos frame and archway
Boundary sharpness between metallic objects and the altar cloth
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'central niche' artifact. If the geometric depth auditor confirms it is a flat 2D black shape rather than a 3D hole, this is a significant structural failure. Also, evaluate if the wood texture is merely low-resolution or genuinely AI-hallucinated (repetitive patterns).
